#### Create

```text
public static PPDS.Auth.Credentials.ICredentialProvider Create(PPDS.Auth.Profiles.AuthProfile profile, System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo> deviceCodeCallback = default, System.Func`2<System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo>,PPDS.Auth.Credentials.PreAuthDialogResult> beforeInteractiveAuth = default)
```

Creates a credential provider synchronously. Prefer CreateAsync when possible for better performance with secure store lookups.

- Parameter `profile`: The auth profile.
- Parameter `deviceCodeCallback`: Optional callback for device code display.
- Parameter `beforeInteractiveAuth`: Optional callback invoked before browser opens for interactive auth. Returns the user&#x27;s choice (OpenBrowser, UseDeviceCode, or Cancel).

Returns: A credential provider for the profile&#x27;s auth method.

Remarks: This overload does not support secure credential store lookups. Use CreateAsync for full functionality.

#### CreateAsync

```text
public static System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.ICredentialProvider> CreateAsync(PPDS.Auth.Profiles.AuthProfile profile, PPDS.Auth.Credentials.ISecureCredentialStore credentialStore = default, System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo> deviceCodeCallback = default, System.Func`2<System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo>,PPDS.Auth.Credentials.PreAuthDialogResult> beforeInteractiveAuth = default, System.String clientSecretOverride = default, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Creates a credential provider for the specified auth profile.

- Parameter `profile`: The auth profile.
- Parameter `credentialStore`: Optional secure credential store for looking up secrets.
- Parameter `deviceCodeCallback`: Optional callback for device code display.
- Parameter `beforeInteractiveAuth`: Optional callback invoked before browser opens for interactive auth. Returns the user&#x27;s choice (OpenBrowser, UseDeviceCode, or Cancel).
- Parameter `clientSecretOverride`: Optional client secret that takes priority over env var and credential store lookups.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Returns: A credential provider for the profile&#x27;s auth method.
